item.title: Holy F*ck #3
item.description: Jesus takes the fight directly to Zeus and Isis, the two mythological gods leading a horde of desperate, worship-hungry deities! But do Jesus, Satan, and Sister Maria actually stand a chance? And can they keep their sht together long enough to stop the coming madness?
